body_md:
Six electrician businesses with a Miami-area license address are listed here, each with a Florida Certified Electrical Contractor license shown as Current, Active. For each one, an owner or officer is named on the business site and/or a Florida filing, and those sources do not state or list a parent company. License numbers and dates come from the Florida DBPR Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board lookup; phone, website, hours, and services appear only where they were recorded.

## How we picked

Each business was checked on a Florida DBPR Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board lookup. That check recorded license number, type (Certified Electrical Contractor), status (Current, Active), license address, original licensure date, and expiration. Ownership was checked on the business's own site where a site was listed, and on a Florida LLC, corporation, or Sunbiz filing. A business is included when that material names an owner or officer and no parent company is stated or listed. Service area, years, stated services, and stated hours are used only as supplied. Where a phone or website is present, contacts were checked on 2026-10-27. Each license fact links to that business's DBPR source page.

## At a glance

- All six licenses are Certified Electrical Contractor and Current, Active, and each lists an expiration of 08/31/2028. Original licensure dates run from 10/05/2004 (Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc., EC13002232) to 03/24/2021 (Baltic Electrical LLC, EC13010446).
- Baltic Electrical LLC (Miami, FL 33179) and Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC (Miami, FL 33177) both state Miami-Dade and Broward Counties. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. (Homestead, FL 33033) states Homestead and the Miami area, including Homestead to Aventura.
- C.G. Electrical & Consulting Services Inc. (Miami, FL 33166), Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc. (Miami, FL 33175), and DR Electric Services Corp (Miami, FL 33170) each have a Miami, Miami-Dade County license address, and the note for each says a certified license is statewide.
- Stated services are not the same. Baltic Electrical LLC lists panel upgrades, commercial buildouts, smart home, EV chargers, and building recertification, plus free estimates and bilingual EN/RU. Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC lists repairs, panel upgrades, generators, EV chargers, commercial work, and lighting, plus free estimates and Se Habla Espanol. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. lists residential and commercial electrical services, with emergency service stated as available 24 hours and same-day service stated.

## Things to know before you go

Match the service-area wording to the job location. Baltic Electrical LLC and Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC name Miami-Dade and Broward Counties. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. names Homestead and the Miami area, including Homestead to Aventura. For C.G. Electrical & Consulting Services Inc., Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc., and DR Electric Services Corp, the supplied note is a Miami license address in Miami-Dade County and that a certified license is statewide.

Hours are in the record for two businesses. Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC lists Mon–Sat 7:00 AM–8:00 PM, with Sunday emergency only. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. states emergency service available 24 hours and same-day service. No hours field was included for the other four.

A phone and website are included for Baltic Electrical LLC ((786) 840-8585, balticelectrical.com), Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC ((305) 896-7742, legacy-electricalcontractor.com), and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. (786-930-4300, esucorp.com). Phone and website fields were not included for C.G. Electrical & Consulting Services Inc., Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc., and DR Electric Services Corp. Contacts that are present were checked on 2026-10-27.

The years line is not always the license date. Baltic Electrical LLC is described as serving South Florida since 2020; original licensure is 03/24/2021. Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC is described as serving South Florida since 2018; original licensure is 01/25/2019. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. is listed as since 2016, with original licensure 11/22/2016. For the other three, the years field is a Florida filing date: C.G. Electrical & Consulting Services Inc. 01/22/2013, Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc. 02/26/1996, and DR Electric Services Corp 10/20/2014 (document P14000086294).

Named people in the ownership notes are Alexandr Anissimov (Baltic Electrical LLC; site: founder and owner; LLC filing: manager), Frank Herrera (Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC; site: founder and owner; LLC filing: CEO), Ivan Alonso (Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc.; site: owner; corporation filing: President), Corbari Garcia (President and registered agent) and Leyanis Garcia (Vice President) for C.G. Electrical & Consulting Services Inc., Hector Diaz (PTD) and Carmen Diaz (SVD) for Powerline Electrical Contractors, Inc., and Dalien Ramirez (President and registered agent) for DR Electric Services Corp.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses shown as active?

Yes. Each is a Certified Electrical Contractor license marked Current, Active on the Florida DBPR lookup used here, and each lists an expiration of 08/31/2028. The numbers are EC13010446, EC13008804, EC13007781, EC13004208, EC13002232, and EC13006472. The linked DBPR page is the source for that status.

### What does independently owned mean here?

The ownership note names an individual and does not state or list a parent company. For Baltic Electrical LLC, Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC, and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc., the own site names the owner and a Florida filing lists that person as manager, CEO, or President. For the other three, the note is a Sunbiz filing or state filing summary, with titles of President, Vice President, PTD, SVD, or registered agent, and no parent company listed.

### Do they state the same area and the same work?

No. Baltic Electrical LLC and Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC state Miami-Dade and Broward Counties. Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. states Homestead and the Miami area, including Homestead to Aventura. The other three note a Miami, Miami-Dade County license address and that a certified license is statewide. A services list is included only for Baltic Electrical LLC, Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC, and Electrical Services Unlimited, Inc. Language notes appear only for Baltic Electrical LLC (bilingual EN/RU) and Legacy Electrical Contractors LLC (Se Habla Espanol).
